seo.title: 知乎｜烫金是不是真金？电化铝是什么？ / Is Foil Stamping Real Gold?

content:
# 中文回答

烫金通常不是真金。现代包装、礼盒、书刊、标签上的“烫金”，大多数使用的是电化铝烫金膜，也叫 hot stamping foil。它是一种多层复合材料，通常包括基膜、离型层、颜色/金属效果层、镀铝层或颜料层、胶层等。

烫金的原理是通过烫金版加热加压，让膜上的装饰层从基膜上释放，并粘附到纸张、塑料、皮革或其他底材表面。最终效果像金属，但本质上是装饰膜转移，不是把真金压到包装上。

为什么有的烫金会掉？主要与底材、表面处理、膜系列、温度、压力、速度、后道摩擦有关。比如覆膜纸、UV 油墨、低表面能塑料、粗糙皮革，都需要选对膜并先打样。

# English Answer

Foil stamping is usually not real gold. Most “gold stamping” on packaging, gift boxes, books, and labels uses hot stamping foil, also known as metallized foil or electrochemical aluminum foil in Chinese packaging contexts. It is a multilayer decorative transfer material, typically including a carrier film, release layer, color/metallic layer, aluminum or pigment layer, and adhesive layer.

The process uses heat and pressure from a stamping die to release the decorative layer from the carrier film and bond it to paper, plastic, leather, or other substrates. The final effect looks metallic, but it is a decorative transfer layer, not real gold.

If foil falls off, the cause is usually not one single factor. Substrate, surface treatment, foil grade, temperature, pressure, speed, and post-processing friction all matter. Laminated paper, UV ink, low-surface-energy plastic, and textured leather all require correct foil selection and real-material testing.
